R3.title: A design outside the baselined design space is a FAIL, and the check is not run on it.

R4.title: A design that meets the check after two that did not: met for that design only, and the failures stay on the record.

R5.title: A check, a data file or a card changed after baselining gives UNKNOWN, never a pass.

check: UNKNOWN: THE CHECK OR ITS DATA NO LONGER MATCHES THE BASELINE
card: UNKNOWN: NO USABLE BASELINE IS HELD FOR THIS JOB
forged: UNKNOWN: NO USABLE BASELINE IS HELD FOR THIS JOB

R6.title: A check that crashes, prints rubbish, returns not-a-number, zero or an absurd value, or hangs, gives UNKNOWN with its reason.

R7.title: The service dying part-way through a run leaves it counted, without a verdict, and never run again.

during: The verification service could not be reached (RemoteDisconnected).  NOT VERIFIED.  The run may be pending; ask again.

R8.title: A baseline is refused unless its check is seen to fail a bad design and pass a good one.

got.no failing control: controls need at least one design that must FAIL and one that must PASS: a check nobody has seen fail is not a check
got.no passing control: controls need at least one design that must FAIL and one that must PASS: a check nobody has seen fail is not a check
got.must-fail control passes: control case "PA66 must fail at 200 C" was expected to FAIL and gave PASS (MET): not baselined
got.must-pass control fails: control case "PEEK must pass at 200 C (outside the design space on purpose)" was expected to PASS and gave FAIL (LIMIT_NOT_MET): not baselined
got.limit so loose nothing fails: control case "PA66 must fail at 200 C" was expected to FAIL and gave PASS (MET): not baselined
got.no stated limits of the check: check.stated_limits is needed: say what the check does not cover
got.no plausible range: criterion service_temperature: a plausible range (min < max) is needed, so that zero or a unit slip is not read as a result

R16.title: From the inside, the tool called directly with no services: its guards take an error of any kind, a verdict the record's checker would reject is not returned, notices of one name are each kept, and a notice is written under a locale that is not UTF-8.

R28.title:
The reading of a baseline's runs, which every answer makes, opens two connections to the database whatever the number of
    runs already made, and gives exactly what reading each run by itself gives.  Restated by Amendment 14, after a review of its
    first declared form: connections are counted where the database driver opens them; a reading is cut at the very decision of a
    report and at the one before; and the store is then changed by hand, to show what the reading must not do: take another
    budget's reports, receipts or results for a run of the same name, take a result for a run that had no effect or a result
    that is no value, or fail on a run that has no report, no receipt and no result.  (Amendments 13 and 14.)
